body.name: \(L_n\) and \(U_n\)
body.construction: For nonempty \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\), order every coefficient, weight, and atom coordinate as displayed in the sieve definitions, choose the coordinatewise lexicographically least minimizer and maximizer of \(\mu_{\theta}(a)\), and set \(L_n(a)=\max\{-B_Y,\inf_{\theta\in\Theta_{n,\alpha}}\mu_{\theta}(a)-b_{\mu,n}\}\) and \(U_n(a)=\min\{B_Y,\sup_{\theta\in\Theta_{n,\alpha}}\mu_{\theta}(a)+b_{\mu,n}\}\). If \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}=\varnothing\), set \(L_n(a)=U_n(a)=0\) for every \(a\in I\). Compactness and deterministic tie-breaking make the extrema jointly sample-and-index measurable; \(|q_x|\le B_Yf_x\) makes the finite endpoints ordered.
